headline.zh: 蛋白质设计平台工作流

scenario.zh: 为靶向肿瘤受体设计新型治疗性抗体
scenario.en: Design a novel therapeutic antibody targeting a tumor receptor

instruction.zh: 确定蛋白质设计的起点
instruction.en: Define the starting point for protein design

output.zh: 已加载参考抗体骨架，系统将在保留结合域的前提下优化稳定性
output.en: Reference antibody scaffold loaded; system will optimize stability while preserving binding domain

output.zh: 已设定靶点受体序列，系统将探索全新的结合模式和拓扑结构
output.en: Target receptor sequence set; system will explore novel binding modes and topologies

instruction.zh: 选择关键生物物理参数优先级

output.zh: 模型将生成高亲和力候选，可能需要后续表达优化
output.en: Model will generate high-affinity candidates; may require downstream expression optimization

output.zh: 模型将综合考虑可生产性，生成更易验证的序列
output.en: Model will consider manufacturability; generates sequences easier to validate

instruction.zh: 审查生成的蛋白质设计方案

output.zh: 与天然抗体相似度较高，预测折叠置信度强，结合位点保持已知模式
output.en: Higher similarity to natural antibodies; strong folding confidence; binding site retains known motifs

output.zh: 引入非天然氨基酸组合，预测亲和力提升，但需要更多验证实验
output.en: Introduces non-natural residue combinations; predicted affinity gain but requires more validation

instruction.zh: 确认交付给湿实验团队的设计包
instruction.en: Confirm design package for wet lab team

output.zh: 已准备 3 个候选序列、折叠预测及建议的表达系统清单
output.en: Prepared 3 candidate sequences, folding predictions, and suggested expression systems

output.zh: 已列出结合测定、稳定性分析及表达优化的实验步骤建议
output.en: Listed suggested steps for binding assays, stability analysis, and expression tuning

takeaway.zh: AI 蛋白质设计将计算预测与实验验证连接，加速治疗性分子开发周期
takeaway.en: AI protein design bridges computational prediction and experimental validation to accelerate therapeutic development
